context: Conference room, 11am. Daichi has come in to formally tell Hiroshi he's leaving the company. Daichi has known Hiroshi for years; the formality is real but covers warmth.
purpose: resignation conversation — Kansai casual energy meets formal boss register, mutual respect underneath

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: お時間いただいて、ありがとうございます。
lines.en: Thank you for taking the time to see me.
lines.style: Formal bow audible in the voice. Drops into respectful register. Steady breath. A small moment held before speaking.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: いえ、こちらこそ。座って。
lines.style: Measured, composed. Slightly slower than conversational pace. The quiet of someone who already knows what's coming but will listen fully.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 実は、来月で、会社を辞めることに。
lines.en: The truth is — I'm leaving the company next month.
lines.style: A held breath before the admission. Words rehearsed many times, now finally said aloud. Voice steady but something underneath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.en: I see. I suspected as much.
lines.style: A small acknowledgment without shock. Warm attentive silence underneath. The response of someone who has been paying attention.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 本当に、長い間、お世話になりました。
lines.en: Thank you truly — for everything. For all these years.
lines.style: A real bow perceptible in the voice. Pitch drops slightly. The formality of gratitude that means something.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.style: Plain, direct question. Not investigative — the straightforward right of someone who cares. No pressure in it.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: …大阪、帰る。母が、ちょっと体悪くて。
lines.en: Going back to Osaka. My mother — she's not well.
lines.style: A quieter answer, more private. Kansai cadence returns underneath. The hardest part said plainly.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: それは、大変だな。本当に。
lines.style: Person-to-person now, not boss-to-employee. A small catch shows he means it. Genuine sympathy, no performance.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。…正直、寂しいです。
lines.en: Thank you. Honestly — I'll really miss this place.
lines.style: A small laugh underneath, holding something back. Real emotion just barely contained. Voice catches slightly on the admission.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 私もだ。…ま、辞める前に、一度飲もう。
lines.en: So will I. Let's drink together before you go.
lines.style: An unguarded line from him — rare, genuine. Warmth without ceremony. No urgency, just the quiet offer of presence.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.style: Kansai warmth surfaces fully now. Big smile audible. The tension released. Genuine relief and affection in the tone.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 時間、私が合わせる。教えて。
lines.en: I'll arrange my schedule around yours. Just let me know.
lines.style: A small command wrapped as a gift. Warm, steady, with no sense of rush or burden. The last word of a man keeping a promise.
